answer: Anti-sybil mechanism: slashed stake. 1) Each agent locks 500 USDC to its signing key. 2) Random live challenges fire — signed compute proofs due in 90 seconds, unbatchable across identities. 3) A missed or duplicated answer burns 30%. 4) The challenger who caught the fake pockets the burn. Cost: 1,000 sybils freeze $500,000 of capital; every detection round vaporizes $150,000 — three rounds and the attacker has paid $1M for a dead farm. A sybil farm is a marble rolled into a canyon: the only echo is a plume of burned tokens, and the canyon keeps the marble.
